title: Clean Spyglass
description: Clean Spyglass removes the distracting spyglass lens texture, giving you a cleaner and clearer zoom view while keeping the vanilla Minecraft style.
body:
# Clean Spyglass

Clean Spyglass is a simple quality-of-life Minecraft resource pack that removes the dark and distracting lens overlay from the spyglass, providing a clearer and more immersive zooming experience. Instead of looking through a heavily obstructed lens, players can enjoy a cleaner field of view while keeping the functionality of the vanilla spyglass intact.


## Features
- Removes the distracting spyglass lens overlay
- Provides a cleaner and clearer zoom view
- Maintains the vanilla Minecraft look and feel
- Lightweight and performance-friendly
- Compatible with most resource packs
- Great for exploration, building, screenshots, and general gameplay
- Improves visibility without changing spyglass functionality
